newsitem.title: USA: Dell suits end in settlement - law firm.
newsitem.headline: Dell suits end in settlement - law firm.

text.p: A U.S. judge has approved a preliminary settlement for a number of lawsuits filed against Dell Computer Corp over alleged false advertising and alleged use of used parts in new products, a law firm said Monday.

Judge Mary Pearl Williams of the Texas District Court for Travis County approved on April 18 the settlement for about five suits filed against the company in Texas and several states, according to Milberg Weiss Bershad Hynes & Lerach LLP.
A lawyer at the firm said the terms of the settlement will be disclosed on May 9 and a final decision on the settlement will be made in mid-July.

He said consumers who had bought Dell products between May 1, 1991 and December 31, 1995, had later sued the company for allegedly falsely advertising the size of the monitor screen, while others had sued it for allegedly using used parts in new computers.
